item.title: Explore the foundations of Japanese garden design at Birmingham Botanical Gardens
item.description: Friends of Birmingham Botanical Gardens horticulturist Julia Adams will lead a guided stroll through the Japanese Garden on Feb. 27, highlighting the design principles behind these timeless landscapes.

item.title: Regional leaders announce major investment in Deerfoot, Hollywood Bridge Projects
item.description: Mayors from Trussville, Mountain Brook, Homewood and Birmingham joined county and state leaders to unveil major funding for Deerfoot Parkway expansion and long-awaited safety upgrades to the Hollywood Boulevard bridge.

item.title: Mountain Brook to reschedule home business work session after notice error
item.description: Mountain Brook officials will reschedule a work session on regulating at-home businesses after an agenda error listed the wrong date. The council also approved hemp licenses and made board appointments.

item.title: Anna Hartzog, children’s book author and president of Village Editorial
item.description: Montgomery native and founder of Village Editorial shares her path from teaching to hybrid publishing and the family bedtime tale “Eek and Ouch,” now a joyful children’s book.

item.title: Demolition to begin at Brookwood Village site in early March
item.description: Fairway Investments and Pope & Land Real Estate will begin demolition at Brookwood Village in early March as part of long-term redevelopment plans.

item.title: Village2Village Run set for March 7
item.description: The Mountain Brook Chamber will host the Grand Bohemian Village2Village 10K/7.5K on March 7 at Lane Parke. Runners will enjoy awards, medals and a festive afterparty with food, music and family fun.

item.title: Mountain Brook triathlete Andy Grant qualifies for Kona Ironman World Championship
item.description: Mountain Brook triathlete Andy Grant, a seven-time world championship qualifier, recently earned a Kona spot after Ironman Chattanooga. He leads Magic City Tri Club, emphasizing discipline, consistency and community.

item.title: Lady Spartans fight back, fall in regional final
item.description: Mountain Brook's girls basketball team finished its season in the Northeast Regional final on Wednesday morning.

item.title: Get to know: Artist Sherri Springer
item.description: An Alabama artist began with coastal commissions during COVID and now focuses on Birmingham. She treasures painting with her late mother and participates in local markets, gallery shows and a new shop space.

item.title: Brunch with the Bachelors returns to Birmingham Zoo
item.description: Guests can enjoy brunch and a behind-the-scenes elephant experience March 7 at the Birmingham Zoo, featuring Bulwagi, Luti and Gadze.
